name: Bollullos Par del Condado (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of blue, white and blue, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Bollullos Par del Condado (a key and a vine on yellow within a wreath).
history: Municipal flag of Bollullos Par del Condado; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Bollullos Par del Condado arms — key and vine on yellow within a wreath
